main.summary: Delegates Command Execution to a CliWrap Command with binary standard output and error streams.

property.name: Buffered
property.summary: True to return a BinaryCommandResult with binary buffers.

property.name: CommandResult
property.summary: Most recently completed CliWrap command result.
property.returns: The last completed streamed or buffered console command result; it is a shared snapshot and is not tied to a particular activity when executions overlap.

property.name: ConsoleCommand
property.summary: CliWrap command delegated by this command.

property.name: Observer
property.summary: Observer for streamed binary command events.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.param: True to publish a BinaryCommandResult with binary buffers.
